exact_statement: For a protein count N in {0,...,M} with causal predictable single-molecule birth intensity at most B and independent per-molecule loss rate gamma, the pathwise coupling to a capped constant-arrival immigration-death chain implies liminf_t Pr[N_t<h] >= (sum_{n=0}^{h-1}(B/gamma)^n/n!)/(sum_{n=0}^{M}(B/gamma)^n/n!) for each 1<=h<=M, when both chains start at the same count.
assumptions: Accepted birth intensity is predictable and uniformly at most B
Per-molecule independent loss at constant rate gamma
No anticipative control or batch bursts
status: internally_reconstructed_model_theorem; core domination is established prior art; novelty not established
novelty_boundary: Hemberg and Barahona (2007) already dominate bounded Hill/Monod gene-expression propensities by a first-order immigration-death process for exact stationary sampling. Our finite-cap low-tail formula and resource-floor wording are direct corollaries; no priority claim.
costs: Throughput cap B protein completions per unit time
Feedback/controller state and sequence acquisition are not charged by the mathematical theorem
falsifier: Find a process satisfying every listed assumption with liminf low-copy probability below the truncated-Poisson comparator tail; the coupling proof predicts this cannot occur.
next_gate: Independent mathematical review and experimental calibration of B, gamma, and M for one specified circuit; seek a genuinely stronger theorem before any novelty claim.

exact_statement: At equal stationary mean and hence equal mean accepted production in the finite model M=10, gamma=1, the regulated chain lambda_n=10-n has binomial stationary law and lower dropout and P[N<5] than the mean-matched constant-arrival truncated-Poisson chain; its peak birth rate is higher.
assumptions: Constant baseline attempted birth rate selected to match stationary mean
novelty_boundary: Illustrates that peak-throughput matching and average-production matching are different resource contracts; not claimed novel.
costs: Both mean accepted birth rates are 5
Feedback peak rate is 10 while constant baseline peak is about 5.1041217944
falsifier: Exact stationary formulas or numerical computation fail to reproduce the listed distributions and tails.
next_gate: Keep as a comparator audit when evaluating any broader feedback-versus-reliability statement.
